inventory_status_reason: The 97 entries below are the complete asset set of the redesigned carbonphysics.ai site (build 2026-09-22, upload archive carbon-site-upload-v2.zip). Completeness is established by construction rather than by platform enumeration: the archive IS the directory handed to `wrangler deploy --assets`, and a static-assets deployment publishes exactly that directory. Provenance chain: (1) the previous live version (dashboard upload carbon-site-upload.zip, 2026-09-22) was verified path-by-path by authenticated download against the same build inventory (97/97 digests matched, 0 mismatches, 0 errors); (2) this revision changes exactly nine text files against that verified set (listed in `changes_since_previous_live`) and adds or removes no path; (3) after deployment the runbook re-verifies every path below by GET on both hostnames.

changes_since_previous_live.change_summary: Header/footer: `Ask Carbon` utility link (desktop right cluster and mobile sheet) pointing at /?ask-carbon=open with an in-place open on the homepage; `Start a Project` now targets /workbench/. Inline site script gained the launcher click handler. No other content changed.

homepage_source_authority.note: The homepage source is the redesigned site's own index.html (entry below, sha256 99be1318…). It needs no owner-upload reconciliation: the build directory is the reviewed source. The production bundle intentionally REPLACES index.html with the integrated homepage; every other entry must survive byte-for-byte.

release_authorization.note: Asset completeness is NOT release authorization. This manifest says only which bytes must survive a deployment. Publication and public activation remain governed by the release decision packet and the owner's named-operator authority.

deployment_target_observed.source: Cloudflare Dashboard (authenticated as the account owner) on 2026-09-22; version id to be captured by `npx wrangler deployments list --name carbonwebsite` immediately before the next deployment, per OPERATIONS.md
deployment_target_observed.live_version_note: The redesigned site went live on 2026-09-22 via a Dashboard upload of carbon-site-upload.zip. That version supersedes 5a44ab03-ce7c-4100-ae42-71843b07246a (version 17, 2026-09-12) as the rollback target. Its id must be read from wrangler at deploy time and written here; do not deploy while this field still reads CAPTURE_BEFORE_DEPLOY.
deployment_target_observed.live_version_capture_method: wrangler 4.134.0 `deployments status --name carbonwebsite`, authenticated as carbon.physics.ai@gmail.com; the version reported as serving 100% of traffic.
deployment_target_observed.rollback_target_note: dc5212bb-c84b-4051-9724-74cb21c16711 is the version serving 100% of traffic at capture time (2026-09-22T10:13Z): the inactive Ask Carbon publication. It is the rollback target for the ACTIVATION deployment this manifest now describes; rolling back to it restores the site with Ask Carbon present but inactive, which is the desired failure state for an activation problem. It supersedes 6b339116-ee62-43ac-bda8-cf3baa674551 (the pre-integration redesign, 2026-09-22T07:16Z), 5a44ab03-ce7c-4100-ae42-71843b07246a (2026-09-12) and b99c37f0-c2d2-432b-842a-00b9fb518d96 (2026-09-09), all retained as historical evidence only. Note that the rollback_target_captured guard checks only that this field holds a real version id, NOT that it is still the live one: re-capture immediately before every deployment rather than trusting a value written earlier.

superseded_rollback_targets.description: named in an earlier runbook revision as the rollback target; already stale when written

routing_configuration.source: authenticated `wrangler versions view --json` on carbonwebsite version 5a44ab03-ce7c-4100-ae42-71843b07246a (2026-09-20); the 2026-09-22 dashboard upload kept the same asset configuration
routing_configuration.implication: auto-trailing-slash is why /index.html 307-redirects to / and /workbench/index.html 307-redirects to /workbench/; a preservation recipe must fetch the directory URL, never the literal index.html path. not_found_handling "none" means the site's 404.html is not yet served for unknown paths; switching to "404-page" is a separate, optional change via wrangler.carbonwebsite.toml.
